text: tissakasuttaṃ [594] sāvatthiyaṃ ... tena kho pana samayena bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno . atha kho subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā paccekaṃ dvārabāhaṃ nissāya aṭṭhaṃsu . [595] atha kho suddhāvāso paccekabrahmā katamorakatissakaṃ 2 bhikkhuṃ ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi appameyyaṃ paminanto kodha vidvā vikappaye appameyyaṃ pamāyinaṃ nidhutantaṃ maññe akissavanti . navamaṃ
